display_name: Audiesius, with the martyrs who suffered with him

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Αυδιήσιος και οι συν αυτόν μάρτυρες», with the rank word left off. The page's own heading prints the name in the form «Αυδιησους» in its couplet: «Ὢν αἰχμάλωτος Αὐδιησοῦς τὴν τύχην».

Read out of the title of the life page behind his place in the line for 9 апреля ст. ст., «Мученики епископ Дисан, пресвитер Мариав, Авдиес и прочие 270», which gives the nominative; the day’s line itself has the genitive and prints it inside an unexpanded template token, «@7[Авдиеса]». **He is the one of the three named men who has no name page on this calendar**, so there is no titled nominative to take an epithet from, where Дисан and Мариав both have one and both have «Персидский» on it; azbyka.ru’s heading spreads the epithet over all three as a plural, «Авдиес Персидские», which is not a form for one man. The bare form is what the host of record gives. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding it and `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` a new key with no other holder.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life for the company closes its one sentence of narrative with the year: «Святые мученики епископ Дисан, пресвитер Мариав, Авдиес и прочие 270 приняли мученическую смерть (+ около 362 - 364) от персидского царя Сапора II», about 362 to 364, and its day line prints the same bracket, «(362-364)». azbyka.ru’s calendar for the civil 22 April carries that sentence word for word with «† около 362–364». **saint.gr dates the same company differently**: its heading for the entry under Audiesius’s name reads «(; - 355)» and its prose puts the sack of Byzate in which they were taken «κατά το 30ο έτος της βασιλείας» of Shapur II, whose reign the same page gives as «(325 - 379 μ.Χ.)» — a thirtieth year of 355. Neither reading is chosen; the interval carries both, and every year in it falls inside the reign both pages give. Read 6 October 2026.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Дисана еп., Мариава пресвитера, @7[Авдиеса] и прочих 270-ти (362-364).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Αυδιήσιος και οι συν αυτόν μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 355)». The entry is one line for him and the martyrs with him, and its narrative names three of them — the bishop Heliodorus and the presbyters Desan and Mariab — without enumerating the company, which the page never numbers; so this is one folder, as the corpus already does for a heading whose narrative names some and lists none. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
